children: HG Holdings' revenue fell 0.9% and net income attributable to shareholders declined 53.2% year over year. Lower title premiums and escrow fees weighed on revenue, while operating expenses rose 12.0%, primarily due to higher professional fees; other income, net, increased 3.6%.
¹ Reported as “Total revenues”. ² Reported as “Net income attributable to the Company's shareholders”. ³ Reported as “Diluted”.
: Net premium written decreased 1.2% in the quarter, while nine-month net premium written increased 5.1%, largely on higher premium per file and agency-business volume.
: Escrow and other title fees decreased 1.8% in the quarter; nine-month fees rose 8.6%, primarily on higher title agency-business volume.
: Quarterly fees were unchanged; nine-month management fees increased 28.6% following the June 2025 start of the HP Risk Services Agreement.

: Operating expenses increased 12.0% in the quarter, primarily due to higher professional fees; cost of revenues also rose, reflecting higher underwriting expenses, title claims provisions and search fees.
